stories.title: Nobelpreis 2026 – Wirtschaftsnobelpreis geht an Michael Woodford und Robert E. Hall

en.title: Nobel Prize 2026 – Economics Nobel Prize awarded to Michael Woodford and Robert E. Hall
en.summary: Michael Woodford and Robert E. Hall received the Nobel Prize in Economics for their work on the microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilization.

stories.title: Nobel d’économie 2026: deux Américains récompensés pour leurs travaux sur les moyens de stabiliser une économie

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics: two Americans awarded for work on stabilizing economies
en.summary: Michael Woodford and Robert Hall received the Nobel Prize in Economics for their research on how economic actors' expectations influence the effectiveness of government interventions in stabilizing economies.

stories.title: Die zwei amerikanischen Professoren Robert E. Hall und Michael Woodford erhalten den Wirtschaftsnobelpreis

en.title: American professors Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford receive the Nobel Prize in Economics
en.summary: Two researchers won the economics Nobel Prize for demonstrating how central banks and finance ministries can better mitigate the effects of economic shocks like oil crises, wars, and inflation on countries and consumers.

stories.title: Die älteste Markthalle von Paris wird bei einem Brand zerstört

en.title: Paris's oldest market hall destroyed in fire
en.summary: Paris's oldest market hall was destroyed by fire. The city's mayor described it as a piece of Parisian history, and authorities are investigating the cause of the blaze.

stories.title: Portée par El Niño, la température du Pacifique atteint le record absolu de 29,7°C

en.title: Driven by El Niño, Pacific temperature reaches absolute record of 29.7°C
en.summary: The Pacific Ocean reached its highest recorded temperature of 29.7 degrees Celsius in September, driven by an exceptionally intense El Niño phenomenon, according to the European Copernicus observatory.

stories.title: Implantate-Hersteller Zimmer Biomet entlässt weniger Angestellte als angekündigt

en.title: Implant maker Zimmer Biomet lays off fewer employees than announced
en.summary: Zimmer Biomet will retain some production in Winterthur and reduce layoffs below initially announced levels. Local officials expressed relief at the revised job cut numbers.

stories.title: 490 statt 580 Stellen – Zimmer Biomet streicht in Winterthur weniger Stellen als geplant

en.title: 490 instead of 580 jobs – Zimmer Biomet cuts fewer positions in Winterthur than planned
en.summary: The US medical technology company Zimmer Biomet is reducing its workforce in the Zurich region, but some positions will be preserved instead of eliminated as originally planned.

stories.title: Ältester überdachter Markt – Brand zerstört Traditionsmarkt in Paris

en.title: Oldest covered market – Fire destroys traditional market in Paris
en.summary: Paris's historic Enfants rouges market, one of the city's oldest covered markets, was destroyed by fire overnight. No injuries were reported in the incident.

stories.title: Les Américains Robert E. Hall et Michael Woodford reçoivent le prix Nobel d'économie 2026

en.title: Americans Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford receive 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics
en.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics was awarded to American economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford for their research on economic stabilization mechanisms.

stories.title: Le feu ravage le Marché des Enfants Rouges, plus ancien marché alimentaire couvert de Paris

en.title: Fire devastates the Marché des Enfants Rouges, Paris's oldest covered food market
en.summary: A historic fire destroyed Paris's oldest covered food market, the Marché des Enfants Rouges, overnight Sunday to Monday, causing one minor injury. The monument-classified market was completely ravaged by the blaze.

stories.title: Un incendie ravage le marché des Enfants Rouges, lieu phare de la vie parisienne

en.title: Fire ravages the Marché des Enfants Rouges, landmark of Parisian life
en.summary: A violent fire destroyed the historic Marché des Enfants Rouges in Paris's Marais district overnight Sunday to Monday, gutting all 17 shops inside. No deaths or injuries occurred among residents and merchants.

stories.title: L’océan Pacifique a atteint des températures record pour un mois de septembre sous l’effet d’El Niño

en.title: The Pacific Ocean reached record temperatures in September under the effect of El Niño
en.summary: The Pacific Ocean reached unprecedented September temperatures due to an exceptionally intense El Niño phenomenon, according to the Copernicus observatory. Average sea temperatures reached 21.05 degrees Celsius globally, with some zones approaching 30 degrees.

en.title: BUSINESS REPORTS - Cyberattack disrupts cooling systems at multiple supermarket chains in France
en.summary: A cyberattack has disrupted refrigeration systems across several supermarket chains in France.

en.title: The EU limits Chinese car imports, consumers could face higher prices
en.summary: China and the EU have agreed on import restrictions for hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles. The agreement details were announced Monday, representing another setback for free global trade.

en.summary: Brazilian politicians have achieved digital reach levels barely imaginable in Europe, though German politicians like Ulrich Siegmund and Heidi Reichinnek demonstrate that similar developments are beginning to emerge in Europe.

stories.title: «Gemeinsame Aufgabe»: Der VW-Chef beschwört den Zusammenhalt zur Rettung der europäischen Industrie

en.title: "Common task": VW chief calls for unity to save European industry
en.summary: Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume argues that business and politics must jointly respond to Chinese competition. For VW specifically, this matters greatly as losing this market segment could have severe consequences.
